_comment: Pins and fills for the auto-updating ~/.cache/opencode/models.json price table.
Two jobs: (1) cover models with no table entry, (2) freeze rates for models whose
prices we have already attributed to historical rows, so a models.json refresh does
not silently reprice the past. Keys are '<provider>/<model>'. Rates are USD per
million tokens. 'cache_write_1h' is optional; when absent the Anthropic rule in
pricing.js computes it as 2x input. An entry with all-zero rates is a valid way to
declare a model genuinely free (priced_by stays 'override', billing per source).
